column7: Run enable, decel ramp select, fault reset, coast stop, relay/DO control.
column15: bit 0 = 1 = run enable, 0 = stop; bit 1 = 0 = decel ramp 1 (P-04), 1 = decel ramp 2 (P-24); bit 2 = 1 = fault reset; bit 3 = 1 = coast stop request; bit 8 = Relay control: 0 = open, 1 = close; bit 9 = DO control: 1 = off, 0 = on
bit 0 = DI1; bit 1 = DI2; bit 2 = DI3; bit 3 = DI4

column7: Set 3 or 4 for Modbus control; register = 128 + 12.
column15: 0 = Terminal control; 1 = Keypad, forward only; 2 = Keypad, forward/reverse; 3 = Modbus, internal ramps; 4 = Modbus, ramps written over Modbus (register 4); 5 = PI control; 6 = PI control + AI1 summation; 7 = CAN, internal ramps; 8 = CAN, ramps over CAN; 9 = Slave mode

bit 0 = Ready (no trip, no mains loss, hardware enabled); bit 1 = Running; bit 2 = Tripped; bit 3 = Standby; bit 4 = Fire mode active; bit 6 = At speed (setpoint reached); bit 7 = Below minimum speed (P-02); bit 8 = Overload (current > P-08); bit 9 = Mains loss; bit 10 = Heatsink > 85 °C; bit 11 = Control board > 80 °C; bit 12 = Switching frequency foldback active; bit 13 = Reverse rotation (negative speed); bit 15 = Toggles on every read

column7: Hz with one decimal; negative in reverse (see 2001 bit 13).

column15: bit 0 = DI1 closed; bit 1 = DI2 closed; bit 2 = DI3 (AI-2) closed; bit 3 = DI4 (AI-1) closed; bit 6 = IP66 FWD switch closed; bit 7 = IP66 REV switch closed; bit 8 = Digital output active / analog output > 0; bit 9 = Relay closed; bit 12 = AI1 4-20 mA signal lost; bit 13 = AI2 4-20 mA signal lost; bit 15 = IP66 pot input > 50 %

column7: Fault code per the guide's fault table; 0 = no fault.
column15: 0 = No fault; 1 = Brake channel over current; 2 = Brake resistor overload; 3 = Output over current; 4 = Motor thermal overload (I2t); 6 = DC bus over voltage; 7 = DC bus under voltage; 8 = Heatsink over temperature; 9 = Under temperature; 10 = Factory default parameters loaded; 11 = External trip; 12 = Optibus comms loss; 13 = DC bus ripple too high; 14 = Input phase loss; 15 = Output over current (short circuit); 16 = Faulty heatsink thermistor; 17 = Internal memory fault (IO); 18 = 4-20 mA signal lost; 19 = Internal memory fault (DSP); 21 = Motor PTC thermistor trip; 22 = Cooling fan fault (IP66 only); 23 = Drive internal temperature too high; 26 = Output fault; 41 = Autotune fault; 50 = Modbus comms loss; 51 = CAN comms loss
